<function name="IsPartiallyVisible" parent="CNavArea" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Returns whether this <page>CNavArea</page> can see given position.
	</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<added>2020.08.12</added>
	<args>
		<arg name="pos" type="Vector">The position to test.</arg>
		<arg name="ignoreEnt" type="Entity" default="NULL">If set, the given entity will be ignored when doing LOS tests</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Whether the given position is visible from this area</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
